combinations.magnitude: combination MPE% significantly higher than each drug alone (P<0.001)
combinations.evidence_quote: It was determined that the MPE% value of the combination group was significantly (+++P < 0.001 and &&&P < 0.001) enhanced when compared to the groups administered alone [Figure 1].

combinations.magnitude: combination significantly higher than 50 mg/kg carbamazepine alone (P<0.001) but not than 150 mg/kg PCA
combinations.evidence_quote: It was determined that the MPE% value of the combination group was enhanced significantly (&&&P < 0.001) when compared with the group in which 50 mg/kg carbamazepine was administered alone, but not 150 mg/kg PCA.

combinations.magnitude: glibenclamide significantly reversed PCA anti-allodynic and anti-hyperalgesic actions, PCA effects remained significant
combinations.evidence_quote: Although glibenclamide pretreatment significantly (&&&P < 0.001) decreased both mechanical and thermal thresholds, the effects of PCA were remained significant (+++P < 0.001) [Figure 3].

combinations.magnitude: DPCPX significantly reversed thresholds (P<0.01 mechanical, P<0.05 thermal), PCA effects remained significant
combinations.evidence_quote: Although DPCPX preadministration significantly (&&P < 0.01 and &P < 0.05) reversed the mechanical and thermal thresholds, respectively, the effects of PCA remained significant (+++P < 0.001 and ++P < 0.01) [Figure 4].
